caseStudies.role: Design systems, frontend architecture, runtime governance
caseStudies.title: Unifying portfolio storytelling with active runtime visibility
caseStudies.challenge: The source archives contained strong design material, multilingual copy and runtime ideas, but also duplicate builds and generated noise.
caseStudies.solution: A workspace with shared content, a Next.js production site, Vite preview, static fallback and a status-first runtime registry.
caseStudies.outcome: The site can communicate design quality while also proving system maturity without exposing secrets.

caseStudies.title: Designing a calm interface for complex capability surfaces
caseStudies.challenge: Plugin, skill and connector systems can become visually noisy and cognitively expensive.
process: Expose status instead of raw configuration
Use restrained cards and direct labels
caseStudies.solution: An operations console that summarizes readiness and surfaces blockers without dashboard overload.
caseStudies.outcome: Users can understand system state quickly, then act only where credentials or configuration are missing.

caseStudies.role: 3D art direction, motion governance, frontend performance
caseStudies.title: Making 3D motion feel cinematic without exhausting the interface
caseStudies.challenge: The site needed stronger 3D and motion, but the SEIS philosophy requires calm pacing, accessibility and thermal restraint.
caseStudies.solution: A two-scene Three.js system: a full-bleed orbital hero and a smaller studio showcase for drawings, works and runtime signals.
caseStudies.outcome: The experience feels more premium and memorable while staying testable on desktop and mobile.
